definition: Artificial intelligence (AI) has many applications in warfare, including in communications, intelligence, and munitions control.
details: AI is not limited to new weapons such as drones or strategic means such as cyberwar, as it can affect all forms of military planning.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. That is Military applications of artificial intelligence — a small key that opens a big door.
